newsitem.title: NAMIBIA: NAMIBIA STOCK WEEK - BOND TRADE PICKS UP.
newsitem.headline: NAMIBIA STOCK WEEK - BOND TRADE PICKS UP.

text.p: A further gilt trade was
registered on the Namibian Stock Exchange last week, while other
dealings were dominated by dual-listed shares, exchange
officials said.
N$5.5 million in the government's G982 bond was traded. The
bond matures in June 1998. There are 15 listed bonds issued by
the government and by parastatals, backed by government
guarantees.
In other trade, dual-listed Southern Life traded
shares worth N$3.3 million.
Namibia Sea Products traded 203,500 shares as the
share price fell to a 12-month low of 60 cents, but recovered on
Friday to 68 cents.
Namibia Breweries shares fell to N$2.95 and CIC
Holding traded at N$2,80 before recovering to N$2.95.
Officials said 404,950 shares were traded during the week,
worth N$5.70 million.
The NSE Overall Index eased to 270.73 from 271.13 the
previous week, while the NSE local index dipped to 164.78 from
an earlier 167.04.
-- Windhoek Newsroom +2646 1 245-260
